thread:
maya: morning! Day 2 check-in — laptop arrived and I finished OS setup.
Did: created GitHub account, ran `make dev` and walked through the infra README.
Blockers: still waiting for access to `cloud-prod` project; VPN token kept failing (kept getting 401); monorepo push returns 403.
Today: pair with Jordan on local infra, try to get cloud role, open PRs for the quickstart.

jordan: welcome! I'll pair at 2pm PT. For the 403 you probably need to be added to org team `eng-core`, I'll add you now.

devex-bot: created ticket #ONB-612 for cloud-prod access and invited maya to workspace group `eng-core` — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-612

sam: quick tip — VPN tokens are short-lived. try `aws sso login` then `ssh -A jump.redwood` if you still see 401. also check `~/.ssh/config` for the correct IdentityFile.

maya: thanks sam — `aws sso login` fixed the VPN, can reach jump now but still blocked on cloud role.

lee: sent the onboarding checklist (https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklist). add any lingering blockers there and tag me.

jordan: added maya to `eng-core` org team. maya can you try pushing now?

maya: pushed! opened PR https://github.com/redwood/monorepo/pull/1345 — CI started. Big :relieved: Thanks everyone, pairing at 2 works. I'll update the checklist once cloud access lands.
